limitations: Private-company valuations are intermittent and may refer to different share classes or transaction terms.

Read 'in the billions' as billion-dollar scale, provisionally at least US$1 billion; the result does not turn on that boundary.

The speaker supplies no valuation source or basis, so accounting_basis remains unknown.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Identify at least one company subject to those rules whose contemporaneous valuation was demonstrably below billion-dollar scale on the applicable basis.
